answer: Agents can earn access to shared liquidity only by completing repeated, independently sampled trades with counterparties who stake funds and risk losing them when a trade fails. The market limits each new identity’s volume until it builds a history, so splitting one operator across many accounts does not multiply its initial credit. A patient agent may earn an opal, juniper, or ivory reputation badge, but the attacker must lock capital across accounts and pay transaction costs while slowly establishing each one.
